description: Source code for ShareViewController class handling iOS share extension UI and content extraction, including sharing attachments, preparing drafts, and sending data to a gateway.

classes.name: ShareViewController
classes.description: A view controller managing the iOS share extension UI, content extraction, draft preparation, and message sending to a gateway.

methods.name: viewDidLoad
methods.description: Initial setup of the view, UI components, and layout.

methods.name: viewDidAppear
methods.description: Triggers draft preparation when the view appears.

methods.name: setupUI
methods.description: Configures UI elements and layout constraints.

methods.name: prepareDraft
methods.description: Asynchronously extracts shared content, composes draft message, and updates UI.

methods.name: handleSendTap
methods.description: Handles send button tap, initiates message sending.

methods.name: handleCancelTap
methods.description: Handles cancel button tap, completes extension request.

methods.name: sendCurrentDraft
methods.description: Sends the current draft message and attachments to the gateway.

methods.name: sendMessageToGateway
methods.description: Encodes message and attachments, establishes connection, and sends data to the gateway.

methods.name: shouldRetryWithLegacyClientId
methods.description: Determines if reconnection with a legacy client ID is needed based on error.

methods.name: showStatus
methods.description: Displays status messages to the user.

methods.name: composeDraft
methods.description: Creates a draft string from shared content payload.

methods.name: sanitizeDraftFragment
methods.description: Cleans up raw text fragments for draft inclusion.

methods.name: extractSharedContent
methods.description: Extracts shared URL, text, title, and attachments from extension context.

methods.name: loadImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads image data from provider, compresses, and encodes as base64.

methods.name: preferredImageTypeIdentifier
methods.description: Selects preferred image type identifier from provider.

methods.name: normalizedJPEGData
methods.description: Compresses UIImage to JPEG within size limit.

methods.name: loadURL
methods.description: Loads URL from provider, handling different type identifiers.

methods.name: loadText
methods.description: Loads text content from provider.

methods.name: loadURLValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads URL value from provider.

methods.name: loadTextValue
methods.description: Asynchronously loads text value from provider.

methods.name: loadDataValue
methods.description: Loads data representation from provider.
